messages:
maya: Running onboarding for reranker-v2 int8 PTQ, quick smoke. Saw NDCG@10 drop ~4.7% vs fp16 on one holdout slice.
eli: which slice? long queries or short?
maya: long-form queries (>= 128 tokens). short queries look fine. baseline fp16 ndcg@10 0.421 -> int8 0.402. mrr also down a bit.
raj: did candidate ordering change between runs? sounds like a preprocessing difference can flip ndcg.
maya: good call. I checked hashes of candidate lists for sample id 98765 and order differs by 1-2 positions. suspect query surface variants applied intermittently.
sophie: are we normalizing whitespace/punctuation before rerank? our new tokenizer cleanup step was toggled in the PTQ pipeline.
maya: yes — the PTQ build used the new prep script. command: ```python eval_runner.py --config rerank_onboard.json --holdout long_queries --quant int8 --preproc v2``` output snippet:
```
NDCG@10: 0.402 (-4.7%)
MRR: 0.311 (-2.1%)
sample_mismatch_count: 24/1000
``` 
eli: sample_mismatch_count indicates candidate list diff. we should run a deterministic pass: same preprocessing but different model numerics vs preprocessing diffs.
raj: can you dump the exact preproc diff for one failing sample? also post tokenization boundary for query.
maya: posted diffs to gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/tmp-diff (redacted) — shows extra trailing period removal for some queries.
sophie: tiny normalization changes can change ranking when scores near-tie. suggests we should run NDCG A/B with candidate-order-anchored evaluation (i.e., freeze candidate ordering) to isolate model quantization effect.
eli: +1. also try soft-seed rerun: run with identical candidate order and evaluate only score deltas -> that isolates numeric effect.
ci-bot: PTQ pipeline #8723 completed in 12m — artifacts at s3://redwood/ptq/artifacts/8723
maya: plan: (1) rerun int8 PTQ with preproc v1 (legacy) keeping tokenization identical; (2) rerun int8 with frozen candidate ordering; (3) run AB on full holdout for significance. I'll post results here.
raj: if still regress, surface per-query delta histogram. can help decide targeted fixes (:bar_chart:)
eli: thanks — tossing to you maya to own these reruns. ping when done.
maya: will do, starting now. :rocket:
